scraped.title: Health Sector Policy
scraped.subtitle: Compliance Re-assessment for the Release of the Second Tranche – Health Sector Policy Support Programme II
scraped.clientName: Delegation of the European Union to Egypt
scraped.description: The project aimed to advise the EU Delegation on releasing the second tranche of the Health Sector Policy Support Program (HSPSP-II). The program had three key objectives: improving the quality of public PHC services, increasing client satisfaction and utilization, and…
body: The project aimed to advise the EU Delegation on releasing the second tranche of the Health Sector Policy Support Program (HSPSP-II). The program had three key objectives: improving the quality of public PHC services, increasing client satisfaction and utilization, and strengthening the sustainability of the Family Health Model, particularly in terms of its social, systemic, and financial aspects. The success of the program required close cooperation between the consultants and key stakeholders, including the Ministries of Health, Population, Finance, and Social Solidarity.

ICON-INSTITUTE was contracted by the Delegation of the European Union to Egypt to conduct a Compliance Re-assessment. This comprised among others the evaluation of the general and health-specific benchmarks and the provision of recommendations on disbursement. The compliance assessment report was relevant to guide the decision on the next tranche release.
